column1: # HISTORICAL (2026-11-14 hardening): this set was held out when written (precision 0.984, recall 0.940 then). The analyzer was afterwards fixed for its failures, so it is a regression set now and is NOT independent. See de-grammar-heldout-2.tsv.
# Held-out German grammar sentences. Written AFTER the analyzer and the development corpus (de-grammar-eval.tsv) were
# finished and annotated before they were run; the analyzer was NOT tuned on them. Same format and guideline as the
# development corpus (evidence includes a noun phrase's determiner and adjectives). Reported, not gated: gating a held-out
# set invites tuning on it. One author, small: an estimate of general accuracy at best, with wide uncertainty.
